_comment: Cross-platform wallet-derivation known-answer vectors (ADR-0064). Proves software-wallet address derivation folds the identity BIP-39 passphrase IDENTICALLY on iOS and Android for all four networks. Reference values were generated from the iOS build (the canonical implementation; iOS moves real funds and is on-device verified). The iOS copy (inline in MaknoonTests/WalletDerivationKATTests.swift) and this Android asset MUST stay byte-identical. entropyHex is the 32-byte identity entropy; mnemonic is BIP-39(entropyHex) (32 zero bytes -> the 24-word abandon..art). Each vector fixes the receive address at (passphrase, account): eth = m/44'/60'/<account>'/0/0 (EIP-55), sol = m/44'/501'/<account>'/0' (base58), tron = m/44'/195'/<account>'/0/0 (base58check). btc = BIP84 native-segwit mainnet m/84'/0'/<account>'/0/0 (bech32); present for account 0 only. The empty-passphrase vectors are a harness/back-compat sanity check; the TREZOR vectors are the parity gate that a passphrase-dropping derivation fails.
